headline_marked: 731 children [[dead in measles outbreak]] across Bangladesh
headline: 731 children dead in measles outbreak across Bangladesh
summary: Two more children died in 24 hours, while 833 new cases were reported by the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
details: Two more children died from measles symptoms in the last 24 hours, according to a regular report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) on Saturday.
This brings the total death toll to 731 since March 15, consisting of 638 deaths from measles symptoms and 93 confirmed measles cases.
In the last 24 hours alone, 833 children were reported to be infected with measles or showing symptoms of the disease.
Over the past three and a half months, a total of 87,966 people have been hospitalized with measles symptoms.
Of those hospitalized, 84,218 people have recovered and been discharged from hospitals.
caption:
731 children have died in a nationwide measles outbreak since March 15.

Two more children died from measles symptoms in the last 24 hours, according to a regular report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) on Saturday.

This brings the total death toll to 731 since March 15, consisting of 638 deaths from measles symptoms and 93 confirmed measles cases.

In the last 24 hours alone, 833 children were reported to be infected with measles or showing symptoms of the disease.

Over the past three and a half months, a total of 87,966 people have been hospitalized with measles symptoms.

Of those hospitalized, 84,218 people have recovered and been discharged from hospitals.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Somoy News, Prothom Alo
